title: Te Hoa Tūturu i roto i te Whakamātautau Koura
intro: I raro i te marumaru o tētahi poropiti nui, i whiriwhiria tētahi wairua whaikōrero me te whakapono hei āwhina i tētahi misioni nui. I tū pakari tēnei tangata i te wā i wiri ai te marea, e kauwhau ana mō tētahi hara nui i whakatuma i te pūtake o te whakapono kotahi. I te hokinga mai o te poropiti ki te mātakitaki i te hinganga o te iwi, ehara i te mea he hara te tiaki a tēnei tangata engari he kawenga me te wehi kei wehewehea. Ko wai tēnei pononga pono a Allah?
clues: I whiriwhiria ahau e Allah mō tētahi mahi tapu me tētahi atu mahi, ā, ko taku tūranga he tautoko me te kauwhau.
I homai he māramatanga ki ahau, ā, i haere tahi māua me tētahi karere ki te tū atu ki tētahi kaitukino kaha.
I roto i tētahi haerenga nui, ka piki te karere ki runga i tētahi maunga ko au anake, ā, ka waiho ahau hei tiaki i te iwi.
I tō rātou ngaro, ka hanga e te iwi tētahi whakapakoko koura, ā, ka inoi ahau kia noho pono rātou, engari i whakakahore rātou i taku kupu tohutohu.
I te hokinga mai o te karere, ki tonu i te riri me te pouri, ka hopukina ahau, engari i whakamārama ahau kua hinga ahau, ā, i wehi hoki kei whakatupu raruraru i waenganui i a rātou.
Ko ahau te poropiti i tū i te taha o Mohi, o tōku tuakana, e tautoko ana i tana kawenga, e tū pakari ana hoki ki te whakahē i te karakia whakapakoko.
